nasa-tm-19700002181-snap-8-nak-pump-moto:
Fred Boecker of Lewis Research Center reports start tests for the SNAP-8 sodium-potassium pump motor assembly in this November 1969 memorandum. Two hermetically sealed induction motor pumps were tested in NaK loops. NaK, a sodium-potassium mixture, carries heat in the SNAP-8 space power system.

Tests checked starting on 400-hertz power across wide temperature ranges. Flow resistance was preset by a valve before each start, covering flow rates up to a high maximum. Both pumps started successfully at the hotter stator conditions reported. At colder stator temperatures, both pumps experienced startup difficulties. The pattern tells designers the thermal conditions a SNAP-8 pump needs for reliable starts.
